_doc: Per-uid audit of all 85 Peugeot audit sheets in car-meshes/audit/peugeot/, judged against the owner's rubric in CLAUDE.md and the 2026-08-09 glazing and tyre rulings, which post-date the original Peugeot wave. Every sheet has a staged GLB (85/85), so every car was probed. Glazing is decided ONLY from the glTF via pipeline/ingest/glass_probe.py -- the sheet cannot witness it, because render/handler.py forces transmission=1.0 onto any glass-NAMED material (and the probe's GLASSY pattern covers the French vitre/pare-brise/lunette that this marque uses). Where the file names NO glazing material the probe returns certainty=inferred, no override can fire, and the sheet IS admissible; those were judged by eye. 'ambiguous' is never treated as a fail.
